error[ZBX-E0323]: the container's cgroup view could not be mounted
  while  starting container zbx-9bc203
  cause  mounting the container's cgroup read-only on /sys/fs/cgroup failed:
         operation not permitted (EPERM)
  cause  the kernel refused a cgroup2 mount in the container's cgroup namespace,
         on /sys/fs/cgroup
  name   zbx-9bc203
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   mount_cgroup (57 of 71)
  fix    look for the policy that denies it:   sudo dmesg | grep -iE 'apparmor|seccomp|selinux|userns'
         check what this host allows:          zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0323
